name: Hanging Windshield Wiper Bent Knee with Pause
description: A windshield wiper variation with bent knees and a deliberate pause at each end range of rotation. The knee bend reduces the lever arm making this accessible before the straight-leg version, while the pause maximizes oblique time under tension at the most challenging point.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Hanging Windshield Wiper Bent Knee with Pause in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Hanging Windshield Wiper Bent Knee with Pause.
steps: Step 1: Hang from bar with knees bent at 90 degrees and legs raised to horizontal.
Step 2: Rotate bent legs to one side until thighs are nearly parallel to floor.
Step 3: Pause for 2 seconds at the endpoint.
Step 4: Return through center and rotate to opposite side, pausing again.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: The pause is what makes it effective
